end.summary:
Practised Diwali celebrations, harvest festivals, seasons, and regional differences in India.
Kavya described diyas, rangoli, home decoration, new clothes, and sweets for Diwali.
Identified Onam in Kerala and Bihu in Assam, but needed support to explain regional variation.
Harvest festivals and the idea that everyone celebrates festivals the same way remained mixed up at the end.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised describing festival foods, clothes, decorations, flowers, and links between harvests and seasons. They gave clear details about Diwali and named Onam and Bihu, but the harvest-season link and differences in celebrations were not corrected by the end. At home, look at two festivals from different regions and ask Kavya to compare their foods, decorations, and timing.
